77341.subject: Robinhood Chain's First Mint Sold Out in an Hour
77341.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These were the biggest crypto and DeFi stories today:

* **[Cole Villemain](https://thedefiant.io/news/nfts-and-web3/ousted-pudgy-penguins-co-founder-sells-out-44-444-piece-nft-mint-on-robinhood-chain)**[ sells out a 44,444-piece mint on Robinhood Chain in 54 minutes](https://thedefiant.io/news/nfts-and-web3/ousted-pudgy-penguins-co-founder-sells-out-44-444-piece-nft-mint-on-robinhood-chain)

* **[ENS](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/ens-tokenholders-hand-endowment-control-to-a-staffed-foundation)**[ tokenholders hand endowment control to a staffed foundation](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/ens-tokenholders-hand-endowment-control-to-a-staffed-foundation)

* **[Luke Dashjr](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/bitcoin-bip-editors-remove-luke-dashjr-after-bip-110-fork-stalled)**[ loses his BIP editor seat two days after his fork stalled](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/bitcoin-bip-editors-remove-luke-dashjr-after-bip-110-fork-stalled)

* **[Coinbase](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/coinbase-wins-abu-dhabi-license-for-tokenized-securities-hub)**[ wins an Abu Dhabi license for its tokenized securities hub](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/coinbase-wins-abu-dhabi-license-for-tokenized-securities-hub)

* **[MoneyGram](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/moneygram-ramps-goes-live-on-solana-with-cash-in-in-only-25-countries)**[ takes its cash-to-crypto ramps native on Solana](https://thedefiant.io/converge/tradfi-and-fintech/moneygram-ramps-goes-live-on-solana-with-cash-in-in-only-25-countries)

Cole Villemain opened the mint at 2:18 a.m. ET and called it sold out 57 minutes later. 44,444 tokens, roughly $1.28 million, on a chain that was three weeks old in July. Pudgy Penguins holders voted him out of the project he co-founded in January 2022.

Spritehood is the first NFT sellout of any size on Robinhood Chain, and it lands on a network that has spent a month setting records. [Transactions, total value locked and stablecoin supply all peaked while DEX volume fell 72%](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/robinhood-chains-dex-volume-fell-72-while-transactions-and-deposits-set-records). Uniswap Labs opened a memecoin launchpad there that [out-launched the incumbent on day one](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/uniswaps-new-launchpad-out-launched-pons-on-its-first-day-on-robinhood-chain), and Robinhood's head of product [put the chain at 200 million transactions in 30 days](https://thedefiant.io/converge/podcast/robinhood-s-head-of-product-reveals-how-robinhood-chain-hit-200m-transactions-in-30-days).

That’s defintiely a Robinhood Chain boom. Whether the mint also points to an NFT renaissance is the harder question. Secondary volumes have been flat for two years, and what cleared here in under an hour was speed and a founder's name (albeit a controversial one), sold through a contract Blockscout still lists as unverified. The 44,444 buyers have no published code for the mechanics

## The wild west of trading apps and launchpads

Of the 22 new protocols listed on DefiLlama this week, 6 were launchpads. The number of launchpads earning fees recently hit an all-time high.

Is the recent surge in launchpads and trading apps here to stay, or will this cohort of protocols fizzle out?

Analyzing 52 DefiLlama-tracked [launchpads](https://defillama.com/protocols/launchpad) and [trading apps](https://defillama.com/protocols/trading-app) with at least $1m in lifetime fees, one thing stands out: 90% of them have seen weekly fees drop over 80%.

The median launchpad has round-tripped 99% of its fee peak.

Analyze Categories (https://defillama.com/categories)

Both categories are subject to onchain cyclicality which looks something like this: a narrative or catalyst creates a burst of activity and results in a flurry of fees for the protocols positioned to capture it, then it dissipates.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/703dcc01-14c5-4561-9ee4-e5fd3a76fe9c/weekly-fees-launchpads-vs-trading-apps_2026-08-11.png?t=1786457727)
Caption: 

While several newer entrants to these categories (fomo, Pons, StonkBrokers to name a few) have not yet seen fee drawdowns of over 60%, there is no protocol in this dataset with a multi-quarter track record that hasn't seen an 80%+ fee drawdown at some point.

Even the most durable category leaders are down 85% from their ATH fee weeks, but are still earning: [Pumpfun earns $6m](https://defillama.com/protocol/pump.fun?groupBy=weekly) in weekly revenue and [Axiom earns $5m](https://defillama.com/protocol/axiom?groupBy=weekly). Both gave back a euphoric spike but have captured enough market share to remain successful.
